source.title: Low rainfall cuts Kariba water levels

text:
Low rainfall cuts Kariba water levels

The Zambezi River Authority said that low rainfall in the catchment cut the usable water in Lake Kariba to 15 percent. The Authority reduced the water allocation for power generation for 2027.

Farmers in Southern Province also reported crop failure after the dry season.
